description: 10 military aircraft in border drills; flew within 3 mi of the 2018 agreement no-fly zone, 7 mi of the NLL, and 15 mi of the MDL.
Fired 540 artillery rounds off both coasts in five volleys, including 90 into the Sea of Japan from Jangjon.
Fired ~25 missiles (including SRBMs and SAMs) and 100 artillery shells in multiple volleys; one SRBM landed south of the NLL near Ulleung Island, triggering an air raid alert.
Flew 5 drones across the inter-Korean border into Gyeonggi Province, including 1 over northern Seoul, prompting South Korea to launch counter-drones.
Fired ~200 artillery rounds off the west coast from Jangsan and Deungsan Capes, forcing civilian evacuations on Yeonpyeong and Baengnyeong Islands and triggering South Korean live-fire drills.
launch_region: Jangsan & Deungsan Cape Sector (Yellow Sea Coast)

description: Floated ~260 waste-filled balloons (carrying trash, manure, and batteries) across the border in retaliation against South Korean activist leafleting.
Jammed GPS signals near the Yellow Sea NLL for a second consecutive day, following DPRK threats over ROK vessel movements.
launch_region: Haeju & Kaesong EW Stations (Yellow Sea Border)

description: Delivered 250 new tactical ballistic missile launchers (Hwasong-11D TELs) to frontline units along the South Korean border.
Detonated TNT explosives to sever inter-Korean Gyeongui and Donghae roads 10 meters north of the MDL, deploying heavy equipment to complete the demolition.
Test-fired multiple sea-to-surface strategic cruise missiles off the west coast; flew ~932 mi (1,500 km) in figure-8 orbits for ~125 minutes before striking targets.
launch_region: Inland West Coast Corridor (Pyongnam / Nampo Sector)

description: Launched 600mm MLRS rockets and a Hwasong-11A SRBM in a simulated nuclear attack on U.S. and South Korean forces; the SRBM flew ~497 mi (800 km) on an irregular trajectory with a 62 mi (100 km) apogee into the Sea of Japan.
Fired long-range strategic cruise missiles from Sunan that flew for ~10,200 seconds (~2.8 hours) along designated flight paths over the West Sea, with an estimated range of ~1,243 mi (2,000 km).
Test-fired strategic cruise missiles over the Yellow Sea from the destroyer Choe Hyon, flying for 10,116 to 10,138 seconds (~2.8 hours) before hitting designated targets.
launch_region: Nampo Offshore Sector (West Coast Sea Sector)

description: Fired multiple SRBMs and projectiles from Chongju toward the Yellow Sea; missiles flew approximately 50 miles (80 km).
Test-fired two Hwasong-11D CRBMs toward Ung Island (~45 mi / 72 km range) along with upgraded 240mm MLRS and 155mm self-propelled howitzers.
